section:observation-abort:paragraph:1.sourceLabel: Define abort criteria numerically in advance—for example, an error rate exceeding the acceptable value, p95 latency exceeding the specified value, or a failed health check. For instance, if the error rate abort threshold is set to 2% and 3% is observed in the canary, the threshold has been exceeded. Vague guidance such as “stop if there is a problem” delays decisions.
section:observation-abort:paragraph:1.sourceText: For canary or blue/green deployments, decide how long to wait for observations and how to shift traffic back. If a threshold is exceeded, do not proceed to the next stage; save the evidence and begin investigating the cause.

section:deployment-strategies:misconcept.label: This is incorrect
section:deployment-strategies:misconcept.text: With blue/green deployment, switching traffic back to the old environment is enough to recover from any problem.

section:deployment-strategies:misconcept.sourceText: Even with two environments, traffic switching, shared data, compatibility, and monitoring must be designed separately.
section:deployment-strategies:misconcept.label: Correction
section:deployment-strategies:misconcept.text: Switching traffic back will not restore service if the old version cannot handle data written by the new one. Check data compatibility in advance and agree on what to monitor and when to roll back.

section:observation-abort:paragraph:1.sourceLabel: Définissez à l’avance des critères d’arrêt chiffrés, par exemple un taux d’erreur supérieur à la valeur acceptable, une latence p95 supérieure à la valeur définie ou l’échec d’un contrôle d’intégrité. Par exemple, si le seuil d’arrêt du taux d’erreur est fixé à 2 % et que 3 % sont observés lors du déploiement canary, le seuil est dépassé. Des consignes vagues telles que « arrêter en cas de problème » retardent la prise de décision.

Indicaciones imprecisas como «detenerse si hay algún problema» retrasan la toma de decisiones.

section:deployment-strategies:misconcept.text: Con un despliegue azul/verde, basta con devolver el tráfico al entorno anterior para recuperarse de cualquier problema.

section:deployment-strategies:misconcept.sourceText: Aunque se disponga de dos entornos, es necesario diseñar por separado el cambio de tráfico, los datos compartidos, la compatibilidad y la supervisión.
section:deployment-strategies:misconcept.label: Corrección
section:deployment-strategies:misconcept.text: Redirigir el tráfico no restablece el servicio si la versión anterior no puede procesar los datos escritos por la nueva. Comprueba la compatibilidad de los datos y decide de antemano qué supervisar y cuándo revertir el cambio.

section:observation-abort:paragraph:1.sourceLabel: Definite in anticipo criteri di interruzione numerici, ad esempio un tasso di errore superiore al valore accettabile, una latenza p95 superiore al valore stabilito o il fallimento di un controllo dello stato. Per esempio, se la soglia di interruzione del tasso di errore è fissata al 2% e nel canary si osserva il 3%, la soglia è stata superata. Indicazioni vaghe come «interrompere in caso di problemi» ritardano la decisione.

section:observation-abort:paragraph:1.sourceLabel: 중단 기준은 허용 가능한 오류율 초과, p95 지연 시간의 지정 값 초과, 상태 확인 실패 등과 같이 미리 수치로 정합니다. 예를 들어 오류율 중단 임계값을 2%로 정했는데 카나리에서 3%가 관측되면 임계값을 초과한 것입니다. ‘문제가 있으면 중단한다’처럼 모호한 기준만으로는 판단이 늦어집니다.

section:observation-abort:paragraph:1.sourceLabel: 提前用数值定义中止标准，例如错误率超过可接受值、p95 延迟超过既定值，或健康检查失败。例如，将错误率中止阈值设为 2%，如果在金丝雀部署中观测到 3%，就表示已超过阈值。仅仅含糊地说“有问题就停止”会延误判断。
section:observation-abort:paragraph:1.sourceText: 对于金丝雀部署或蓝绿部署，应确定观测等待时间以及将流量切回的操作。超过阈值时，不要进入下一阶段；保存证据并开始调查原因。

section:deployment-strategies:misconcept.text: 如果旧版本无法处理新版本写入的数据，切回流量也不能恢复服务。应事先验证数据兼容性，并明确切换后监控哪些指标、在什么条件下回退。
